environment: Android 11 emulator running the exact released ARMv7 APK; separate 1920x1080 and 1240x1080 displays. These are not physical Thor photos.
settings: Fill, Sharp pixels, 2x voxel resolution, anti-aliasing Off, 3D blur Off, voxel scenery and battles On.
method: Unmodified screen captures during ordinary gameplay from a normal save; no image generation or retouching.
